program.reachability_limit: Top has no external flush: issued LOAD becomes live MEM atomically and masks IRQ, so killed-D drain waiting is tested by the direct-core control suite, not claimed here.
program.scope: CPU5 ten-class registered cycle producer with unchanged S15 ISA workload; independent per-edge machine-word dependency and owner gold, real CPU-to-Stats profile_next windows and separate AXI observation master
program.termination: Exactly one terminal JALR; bounded already-accepted cold self-JAL tail; shared reset cancels at most one accepted cache-front I request after backend accepted transactions close. Snapshot counters/GPR/RAM precede reset.
program.axi_backpressure_limit: Real bridge WAIT_B/WAIT_R accepts a valid response immediately. This program proves AW/W/AR waits, slave B/R latency and end-to-end ownership; it does not claim long AXI B/R backpressure.
